scopeReview: CED FUN-3.E.2 inverse trigonometric derivatives using inverse identities and chain rule. Uses inverse sine, cosine and tangent on principal real ranges, radians throughout. Reciprocal trig notation distinguished from inverse functions; domain interiors and endpoints checked.
varietyReview: Three core derivative formulas, linear and quadratic compositions, special-point slopes, scaled radical simplification, derivation selection, defined-but-nondifferentiable endpoints, constant inverse identity and exponential composition.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.

optionReview: On the principal inverse-sine range, cosine is positive and equals √(1−x²).
